title: Commonwealth Client
body:
Commonwealth Client is a simple quality of life modpack created specifically to be used on the Commonwealth set of servers. 

Featuring:

- Many optimization mods 
- Visual and technical enhancements
- Some texture and shader options
- Accessibility mods

All in a client only package using under 50 mods!


*Disclaimer*

I have merely compiled mods in this modpack and I am not the original creator of these mods. All credit goes to the original mod developers
